scenario: Add To Assembly on a Part design with unsaved edits: if files.saveAs throws (for example browser storage is full or blocked), the catch at line 211 only logs a warning, and line 215 then replaces the open document with the new Hybrid Design, so the part's edits are lost while the toast reports success.
fix: Return null with an error toast when saveAs fails, before the document is replaced at line 215; only continue after a successful save.

scenario: Rigid Group with two faces of the same component picked and Include Children on: picked dedupes to one component, the check calls .length on the Set returned by M.occSubtree (undefined), so build returns null and no Rigid Group is created and nothing reports why.

A joint renamed to contain '<' or '&' (or a component named that way, shown through D.labelOf) breaks the browser tooltip markup, because the names are inserted into the tip HTML unescaped, unlike the other browser rows which use esc().
fix: Escape the feature name and component labels with an esc() helper before building the tip string.

scenario: A contact set renamed with '<' or '&' produces broken tooltip HTML for its browser row, because s.name and the component labels are inserted unescaped into the tip.
fix: Escape s.name and each component label before inserting them into the tip markup.

scenario: Re-registering the built-in snapshot type with replace:true drops its builtin flag, so featureDef('snapshot') returns a non-builtin definition and the timeline lookup (src/modules/timeline/index.js line 20) treats Snapshot as a module feature.
fix: Keep builtin: true in the re-registered definition, or wrap snapshot.apply without re-registering the type.
